'''Feng''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who served on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Onslaught" /> Feng was slain alongside [[Darth Yun]] on Corellia during [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|the battle there]].

==Powers and abilities==
In combat, Feng wielded a double-bladed red [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and was proficient in her use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] during combat. Her abilities in combat extended to using [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]] and its variation Lightning Storm. Feng could also use [[Force drain/Legends|Death Field]] against her opponents and could also use [[Force Slow/Legends|affliction]] against them in order to weaken them.<ref name="Onslaught" />
